name: What should I prepare before an initial consultation for a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before an initial consultation for a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an initial consultation for a home addition, it's beneficial to gather your thoughts on what new space you envision and how you intend to use it. Consider any specific design inspirations, functional needs, or challenges with your current layout. Having a general idea of your desired timeline and investment range can also be helpful. AKN Design Group values clear communication, and this preparation aids us in understanding your unique goals and developing a customized solution from the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before a consultation, consider your vision, functional needs, design inspirations, and desired timeline and investment range for your addition.
